---
name: Technical debt
about: Track refactors, upgrades, and code health tasks
labels: technical debt
---

## Context
What area has accrued debt and why?

## Debt type
Design, test coverage, performance, security, tooling, documentation.

## Impact
How does this debt affect users/devs? Risk if left unresolved.

## Proposed remediation
Outline the approach and incremental steps.

## Effort estimate
S, M, L with rationale.

## Dependencies
Related features or sequencing constraints.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clear criteria for completion

## Risks
Potential regressions or migration concerns.

## Test plan
Tests to add or adjust for safety nets.

## Definition of done
Code updated, tests passing, docs updated.
